snippet.title: Version 2.6 Teaser - "Encore for an Old Dream" | Zenless Zone Zero
snippet.description:
The stage's spotlight shines on a group of young ladies caught between old dreams and a new world.
"Tonight, we'll gather into the starlight of our wildest delusions... and light up everyone's Gilded Carrot Day!"

—Welcome to New Eridu!—
